convention: CANVAS pixel coordinates of 60_master/final/master_full.tif (26206 x 14489). canvas = mosaic - (-16734, -8279).
purpose: Presentation-stage water mask for the print deliverable (D-015). Defines WHERE water may be, not its exact shape: the shape comes from an ink-constrained flood fill seeded inside these polygons, so the fill snaps to the drafted shoreline and flows into every slip that is open to the bay. Never applied to master_full.tif or to any archival scan.

properties.note: Conservative band lying inside open water at every row: panel A's bay above y~8148, uncovered canvas below it. Both are non-ink, so the two are connected and one seed serves the whole bay.

Cap on how far water may spread. East edge follows the drafted wharf frontage plus margin, bulging at the Pier 22/23 slips so they are reachable. A leak through a gap in the frontage line cannot pass this, so it can never reach Avenue A or downtown.
